Call Here 852 8191 0400 Contact Us | About Us Welcome to Ebco Electronic EBCO ELECTRONIC stands as an industry leader in the open market distribution of integrated circuits, semiconductors (active components), as well as various passive components, including capacitors, resistors, and inductors. Our comprehensive offerings encompass active and passive components, interconnect equipment, power supplies, and more. Beyond our extensive product range, EBCO takes pride in delivering value-added services, specializing in the sourcing and support of obsolete, end-of-life, and hard-to-find components tailored for military, industrial, and commercial applications, ensuring seamless support for your production and legacy systems. Furthermore, one of EBCO's distinguished value-added services lies in its capability to provide ex-works delivery to any location worldwide. This streamlined approach to global logistics ensures efficiency and reliability in our supply chain. Additionally, we excel in meeting the intricate demands of our clients by realizing supplies for Bill of Materials (BOM) lists meticulously prepared for production. At EBCO ELECTRONIC, our commitment extends beyond being a mere distributor; we are a strategic partner dedicated to providing unparalleled solutions and services to meet the diverse needs of our valued clientele. EBCO ELECTRONIC is a technology provider specializing in internet of things (IoT) solutions.
